changes.evidence: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6: after his squad is broken up (Pax and Jaco dead, Snowflake turns on him) and he is held by S.H.I.E.L.D., Sarge awakens as Pachakutiq at the Temple of the Forgotten (episode 12, ep 122), stabs May, sends her through the portal as the signal and sides with Izel to bring their people to Earth (wiki: 'Joining Izel', 'finally siding with Izel'). No stage records this switch.

Runaways S3: after escaping the Dark Dimension, Morgan leads her coven of witches (inducting Nico, episode 7) and takes over Wizard, Robert Minoru naming her CEO at the Wizard party, until Tina banishes her (episode 9-10). Wiki affiliation: Morgan le Fay's Coven; Wizard (formerly). Record has no groups.

owner_calls.question: Record has no groups, but Andre runs the Viking Motel sex-trafficking ring (from his first appearance) until Cloak and Dagger take it down in Cloak & Dagger S2 (around episode 18) and he flees. Add the ring and its end?
options: [["Viking Motel Sex Traffic Ring", "Cloak & Dagger"], ["Independent", "Cloak & Dagger"]]
[["Viking Motel Sex Traffic Ring", "(from the start)"]]
owner_calls.evidence: Wiki: support group used as a cover for a trafficking operation run with Lia Dewan; 'Deschaine and Lia Dewan escaped Viking Motel as Cloak and Dagger took it down.' Affiliation: Viking Motel Sex Traffic Ring.

owner_calls.question: In Spider-Man (2002) Quest takes over Oscorp on condition that Norman steps down as CEO (the board tells him); he then kills the board at the World Unity Festival. Record a departure from Oscorp?
options: Keep [["Oscorp", "(from the start)"]] (he kills the board before the ouster takes effect)
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database: 'the company decided to expand and, in doing so, assumed control of Oscorp on the condition that Norman step down as CEO... the Goblin killed the Board of Directors... thus removed the last threat to his takeover of Oscorp.' Affiliation listed as Formerly: Oscorp (Founder).

options: No, keep it to Sarge's Crew then Izel's Crew
